This Used to Be the Best. I purchased a yearly subscription and genuinely loved how simple and user-friendly the app was. I received weekly credits and would even purchase extra credits when I needed them. Then one day, I opened the app and saw a message saying they had moved to a new platform called Clone AI. Suddenly, I was blocked from using the 200 credits I had already paid for, and I couldn’t even download the photos I had previously created.

I reached out to FaceOff for help, but all I got was the runaround. How can customers trust a company that abruptly changes platforms and disregards existing yearly subscriptions? I’ve been unable to receive a refund, which is extremely disappointing.

I still decided to try Clone AI, but it doesn’t offer the same features that made me love FaceOff. It feels like a copy of so many other AI slop apps on the market. What made FaceOff stand out is now gone. I appreciated that FaceOff allowed you to recreate almost any image using your own face that uniqueness is what set it apart. Testing Clone AI was underwhelming, and with so many apps already offering similar features, I don’t see the value in committing to another yearly subscription.

This situation reflects poor business practices and a lack of consideration for loyal customers.
